GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

3. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.

5. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   D. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

7. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   D. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

14. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

15. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
